{{Quote|I suggest you file a complaint with the Trade Commission on Coruscant.|[[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] to [[Dorvalla Mining]] representative|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
The '''Trade Commission''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that oversaw trade and commerce throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and mediated disputes in such matters.<ref name="CoD" />
